request: Analyze GSE186105 for PMID 35379817 (Sirt6 reprograms myofibers to oxidative type through CREB-dependent Sox6 suppression.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina, paired-end), gastrocnemius muscle, ~20-week-old male mice (S4.15.p1)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of skeletal-muscle-specific Sirt6 deletion (Myl1-Cre; Sirt6 flox/flox) vs WT (Sirt6 flox/flox) on the gastrocnemius transcriptome at basal (untrained) condition (S2.4.p1, FIG4a, GEO overall design). This is a genotype estimand, not an exercise estimand.
final.exercise_factor_in_rnaseq: none: the RNA-seq mice are not described as trained; Figs 2-4 phenotyping is 'at basal condition'; GEO characteristics list only strain, tissue, age, genotype
final.sample_inclusion: n = 3 per genotype ('Each sample was analyzed in triplicate', FIG4a); GEO: WT1/WT4/WT6, KO3/KO6/KO7
planned_contrasts: Sirt6 KO vs WT, gastrocnemius, basal (FIG4a volcano; S2.4.p1); no paper DEG count stated
final.exercise_comparisons_in_paper: Exercise contrasts in the paper are (i) human GSE9103 trained vs sedentary microarray (FIG1a, S4.16.p1; a different accession), and (ii) treadmill performance/Western blots in mice (FIG1b, FIG1d-j, FIG5, FIG6) with no transcriptome profiling.
final.paper_method: FIG4 legend: 'Negative binomial Wald Test using DESeq2 (a)'; S4.15.p1 instead describes StringTie read counts, FPKM filter, log2(FPKM+1), quantile normalization and fold-change significance.
final.paper_results: Top-20 down in KO include CREB targets Ppargc1a, Nr4a3, Nr4a1; Creb1 down (FIG4b, S2.4.p1). No total DEG count stated.

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S10.p1 deposits the paper's RNA-seq as GSE186105. S2.4.p1 and FIG4 use it only for Sirt6 KO vs WT gastrocnemius. S4.15.p1 says RNA came from ~20-week-old male mice with no training protocol; FIG2/FIG3 titles describe the KO phenotype 'at basal condition'. The only transcriptomic exercise comparison in the paper is the human GSE9103 reanalysis (FIG1a, S4.16.p1), which is outside this accession.

checks: S10.p1 names GSE186105 for the paper's RNA-seq
GEO series summary paraphrases the paper's abstract; overall design: gastrocnemius of WT and skeletal muscle-specific Sirt6 KO mice
6 GSM samples (3 WT, 3 KO, 20 weeks, gastrocnemius) match FIG4a triplicates and S4.15.p1
matrix columns WT1/WT4/WT6/KO3/KO6/KO7 equal the metadata 'description' field

ownership.reasoning: Paper data-availability statement and GEO series description agree; sample counts and tissue match.

alignment.reasoning: The deposited table has _Read_Count, _FPKM and _TPM columns per sample; keep the read-count columns and strip the suffix so WT1..KO7 match the metadata 'description' field exactly. geno is a formula-safe alias of the GEO genotype characteristic.

matrix.reasoning: The _Read_Count columns are 100% integer, library sizes 45-63 M, StringTie read counts (S4.15.p1 'relative abundances of the gene were measured in Read Count using StringTie'); the FPKM/TPM columns are dropped by the column pattern. The FIG4 legend's DESeq2 route matches this input. Matrix type is not ambiguous; it does not change the design verdict below.

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: GSE186105 contains only untrained WT vs muscle-specific Sirt6 KO gastrocnemius (3 vs 3); there is no exercise, training, sedentary, or time-after-exercise factor in the metadata, the GEO design, or the paper's description of these RNA-seq mice (S2.4.p1, FIG4a, S4.15.p1). The paper's genotype contrast (KO vs WT) is a different estimand and cannot be relabelled as an exercise effect; the paper's transcriptomic exercise comparison uses human GSE9103 (FIG1a, S4.16.p1), a separate accession not requested here.

candidates.reason_rejected: genotype, not exercise; would misrepresent a knockout effect as an exercise effect
different accession, outside the requested GSE186105 scope

design.reasoning: The requested estimand (exercise effect on gene expression) is not identifiable from this sample set; no review would change that, so the case is refused rather than sent to manual review.

discrepancies.paper: FIG4 legend: DESeq2 negative binomial Wald test
discrepancies.data: S4.15.p1 describes log2(FPKM+1) + quantile normalization and fold-change significance
GEO: TruSeq Stranded mRNA LT, NovaSeq 6000
